videos.title: Alien Sunrise Over a Megacity 🌅 ASCII Ambient Visualizer #shorts
videos.description:
The sun breaches the horizon of an alien megacity, and volumetric god rays spill across a sky built entirely from ASCII characters. 🌅

Clipped from the 2-hour ambient dub & ASCII visualizer "Alien Megacity Vista: 2-Hour Ambient Dub & ASCII Visualizer (40Hz Sub-Bass)". 

Original ambient and trip-hop music by Seiler Asterces. The visual is a deterministic real-time simulation coded in a single file

videos.title: Jade Code Reef 🌊 Deep Ocean Ambient #shorts
videos.description:
A coral reef grown entirely from code. Jade light drifts down through the midnight zone while glyph fish and jellyfish glide through algorithmic seaweed.

🎧 Headphones recommended. The full soundscape is a 40 BPM ambient drone in C Major with binaural panning.

Made for focus, study, sleep and decompression. If it brings you peace, a like or subscribe helps me build more immersive worlds. Thank yo
